name: I am dead
source:
You aren't supposed to cheat death. No one is.

All will be well. Until it isn't.

Over, and over, and over.

Until, you aren't.

[From [url=https://milksalads.itch.io/i-am-dead]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你不应该欺骗死亡。没有人是。

一切都会好起来的。直到它不是。

一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍。

直到，你不是。

[来自[url=https://milksalads.itch.io/i-am-dead]Itch.io[/url]]
